verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature, but some data is reachable or already portable. Review configuration and custom agents live in a plain `cubic.yaml` file in your own repository (cubic-docs-11, cubic-docs-67). The Analytics API exposes PR-level data (cubic-docs-16), and the MCP server can read review findings (cubic-docs-72). This gives partial programmatic access rather than a true exit path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, open-format export of learned memory/feedback, wiki and scan results, an account/data deletion or offboarding process, and independent corroboration that users can leave with their data.
